title: Idealized modeling of stratospheric aerosol injection deployment scenarios with two non-cooperative actors
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00022J, Paper
Open Access

Anni Määttänen, François Ravetta, Jérôme Bureau, Thibaut Lurton, Olivier Boucher
Solar radiation management scenarios of two non-cooperative actors deploying stratospheric aerosol injection (SAI) can lead to a free-riding situation, or missing the climatic targets due to temperature oscillations induced by intermittency.
